title: briza media var. pilosa
intro: Briza media var. pilosa, commonly known as Quaking Grass, is a plant species within the Poaceae family, characterized by its delicate, drooping panicles and fine, hair-like leaves. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory function, and act as an antispasmodic agent. The therapeutic actions of Briza media var. pilosa include its antitussive, expectorant, and anti-inflammatory properties, making it a potential remedy for conditions such as coughs, bronchitis, and asthma. The bioactive constituents of Briza media var. pilosa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
